introduction.en: Inflation indices are essential tools for measuring price changes in an economy. While WPI tracks wholesale prices, CPI tracks retail prices.
introduction.hi: Inflation indices are essential tools for measuring price changes in an economy. While WPI tracks wholesale prices, CPI tracks retail prices.

body.en: WPI covers only goods and is used for policy formulation. CPI covers both goods and services, reflecting the actual cost of living. The RBI shifted to CPI because it better represents the consumption basket of households and is more effective for inflation targeting.
body.hi: WPI covers only goods and is used for policy formulation. CPI covers both goods and services, reflecting the actual cost of living. The RBI shifted to CPI because it better represents the consumption basket of households and is more effective for inflation targeting.

conclusion.en: The shift to CPI ensures that monetary policy is more aligned with the ground reality of consumer prices, fostering better economic stability.

valueAddition.en: Urjit Patel Committee Report recommended the shift to CPI.
